description.html: Resun CR-250 are porous ceramic rings in a 250 g pack, intended for biological filtration in aquarium filters. The hollow shape and porous surface provide a large area for beneficial bacteria to settle on, while water flows through the rings easily.

These bacteria convert ammonia from waste and leftover food into nitrites and then into less harmful nitrates. A stable bacterial colony is the foundation of healthy water, so biological media is one of the most important parts of any filter.

Place the rings in the filter after the sponge or filter wool, so they receive water that has already been mechanically cleaned. They fit canister, hang-on and internal filters with a media compartment. They are not replaced, only rinsed occasionally in aquarium water, never under the tap, so the bacteria survive. A 250 g pack is enough for the compartment of a smaller filter or as a top-up for a larger one. In a new aquarium, bacteria need several weeks to settle, so add fish gradually.
